items.title: Close out your next roadmap tasks
items.body: Finish the open tasks on your nearest milestone. Shipped work is the clearest product signal.

items.title: Get your key agreements signed
items.body: Send your founders' agreement or first customer contract for e-signature and get it fully signed.

items.title: Track your money in and out
items.body: Record this month's income and expenses so your runway and burn are based on real numbers.
